name: PiENu (PIENU)
notes: Kind is muon_precision as the nearest kind for a pion-decay experiment. A PIENU 2018 proceedings (arXiv:1809.10314) reports a heavy-neutrino limit; the full-dataset branching-ratio result was still in progress at last report.
The experiment is also written PIENU; the official site names it "PiENu".

physics_goals.quote: to provide a sensitive test of electron-muon universality in weak interactions
physics_goals.value: Measure the pion decay branching ratio to provide a sensitive test of electron-muon universality in weak interactions

summary.plain: An experiment at TRIUMF in Vancouver that compared how often a charged pion decays to a positron and to a muon. Its 2015 result agrees with the Standard Model and tested electron-muon universality to 0.1 per cent.
summary.technical: PIENU at TRIUMF (M13 beam channel, 75 MeV/c pi+ stopped in a scintillator target, NaI(Tl) plus CsI calorimeter): R_e/mu = (1.2344 ± 0.0023 stat ± 0.0019 syst) x 10^-4 from a partial 2010 dataset; data taking 2009-2012; full-dataset analysis in progress at last report.
